dishes.name: Urfa kebab
dishes.desc: Hand-chopped lamb, mildly seasoned and grilled on a wide skewer, served with onion, tomato and lavash. The meat is traditionally chopped with a zırh knife and eaten without the hot spice of Antep.

dishes.name: Urfa çiğ köfte
dishes.desc: Bulgur kneaded with tomato paste, spices and isot pepper, wrapped in lettuce. In Urfa it is now made without raw meat and sold at stalls across the old town.

dishes.name: Şıllık
dishes.desc: Thin pastry sheets soaked in grape molasses with a layer of walnuts or pistachios and a milky syrup. A traditional Urfa sweet seldom found outside the province.

dishes.name: Urfa lahmacun
dishes.desc: Very thin flatbread topped with minced meat, tomato and pepper, baked in a stone oven and rolled with parsley and lemon. Urfa claims it as one of its signature foods.

dishes.name: Lebeni soup
dishes.desc: Yoghurt soup with chickpeas and wheat, finished with mint and chili butter. A tangy comfort dish from Urfa home kitchens and local restaurants.
